audit.why: 52.63% over 22 games, diff FAV, difficulty 4/10 — consistent with a lane you own from 2 to 6 and lose after two AP items. The mirror audit read the same way.
audit.corrected: Kept FAV 4/10; the lane is decided pre-6 and by whether he gets to two items even.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Level 1 to Mordekaiser and gave Level 6 and First item away (Skill / Kassadin), contradicting the packet chart and their own whys text.
audit.why: Packet chart is Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Kassadin. whys[0] says level 1 is a wash; whys[4] says Realm of Death deletes him; whys[5] says all-in for the kill on first item. Rows 0, 4 and 5 were wrong on both layers.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 4 and 5 flipped in matched full/content pairs with ratings rescaled; row 6 stays Kassadin.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page claims Riftwalk has a long cooldown he cannot kite with, and calls Void Stone a shield.
audit.why: Kit file: Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s from rank 1 — it is never on a long cooldown. What actually limits him is the escalating mana cost on repeat casts ('Multiple Riftwalks in a short period of time cost additional Mana'). Void Stone is flat magic damage reduction plus unit-collision ignore, not a shield; the shield comes from Null Sphere. Building advice around a fake cooldown gets players killed mid-chase.
audit.corrected: whys[3], mid, whys[2], spikes[0].text and report[5].t now say mana cost, not cooldown, and separate Void Stone from Null Sphere's shield. Nether Blade's 7s auto reset added as the burst tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Commit on Riftwalk's cooldown' is not a real window.
audit.why: At 2s late-rank there is no cooldown window. Force Pulse is his punishable spell at 21/20/19/18/17s, and your Death's Grasp is 16/14/12/10/8s.
audit.corrected: Covered in report[5].t and whys[3]; the real gate is his mana bar, not a timer.

audit.why: Both packet suspectNames (Null Sphere's, Death's Grasp's) are false positives — the possessive form tripped the matcher. Both are the real names in the kit files.

edits.before: With Q+W+E you yank him in with Death's Grasp and Q-smash through his weak passive shield while Darkness Rise ticks — he can't trade back from melee.
edits.after: With Q+W+E you yank him in on a 16s Death's Grasp and Q-smash while Darkness Rise ticks — Void Stone only cuts magic damage, it is not a shield.

edits.before: Darkness Rise grinds him down in extended trades and Riftwalk's cooldown is still too long for him to kite your aura safely.
edits.after: Darkness Rise grinds him down: Riftwalk is 5s at rank 1, but repeat blinks cost escalating mana, so he can't kite your aura for long.

edits.before: Q+W online: your Obliterate single-target smash chunks him and banks an Indestructible shield, while all Kassadin has back is one Null Sphere silence and his weak passive shield.
edits.after: Q+W online: your Obliterate single-target smash chunks him and banks an Indestructible shield, while all Kassadin has back is one Null Sphere on 9s and the small shield it leaves him.

edits.before: "This is your takeover window. Through 4-5 your Darkness Rise aura grinds him down in any extended trade, and Riftwalk's cooldown is still far too long for him to reliably blink out of it. At 6, R flips the lane open: Realm of Death drags him into the 1v1 shadow realm where there's nowhere to Riftwalk to, and your E-pull plus aura burst him before he can kite. Force every all-in NOW — shove, freeze him low, and punish each time his blink is on cooldown. Every kill you land is six Riftwalk charges and a chunk of gold he never gets to scale with."
edits.after: "This is your takeover window. Through 4-5 your Darkness Rise aura grinds him down in any extended trade, and Riftwalk's escalating mana cost stops him repeat-blinking out of it. At 6, R flips the lane open: Realm of Death drags him into the 1v1 shadow realm where there's nowhere to Riftwalk to, and your E-pull plus aura burst him before he can kite. Force every all-in NOW — shove, freeze him low, and punish him whenever his mana is spent. Every kill you land is gold and levels he never gets to scale with."

edits.before: Track Kassadin's Riftwalk: His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. When it is down — E-pull + Q, then R the 1v1.
edits.after: Riftwalk costs escalating mana, not cooldown. Nether Blade's 7s auto reset is his burst tell — step back on the wind-up, then E-pull.

edits.before: Whiffing Q into the wave and trading with no passive stacks — un-isolated Obliterate hits soft, and without Darkness Rise you lose most even exchanges.
edits.after: Realm of Death is 140/120/100s — spending it early wastes your only answer to a scaled Kassadin, who blinks every 2s once Riftwalk is maxed.
